Add a SMART Brick from All-In-One Sets 75421, 75423 or 75427 (sold separately) for interactive play with motion-activated, dynamic sounds and lights, including AT-ST and speeder bike engine noises, AT-ST walking sounds and laser-shooting battles. Kids can build with confidence using the LEGO Builder app – zoom, rotate in 3D and track progress with easy-to-follow digital instructions. A supercool Star Wars gift for kids, boys, girls and fans ages 8 years old and up, this set contains 347 pieces.
